title: Undergraduate Programmes – January 2027 Intake
about: African Leadership University (ALU Rwanda) is accepting applications for its January 2027 undergraduate intake, including the Entrepreneurial Leadership and Software Engineering bachelor's tracks. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and close on 30 November 2026.
requirements: Applications reviewed on a rolling basis; seats for the preferred intake are limited

upskill.name: Prompt Engineering for Software Development
why: field "software engineering" (Software Engineering bachelor's track) → "Use prompting techniques to generate code from functional requirements while specifying programming language, constraints, dependencies, and expected behavior."
"Software Engineering bachelor's track" → "Apply structured prompts to code review and refactoring tasks in order to assess readability, maintainability, correctness, and potential improvements."
